## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

[A medical professional in blue scrubs examines a brain scan image.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# The Power of Answers

Supplying advanced digital imaging to healthcare professionals and organizations across the globe.

[Get Answers][49]
Play Pause

## The FUJIFILM Sonosite Portfolio

Every FUJIFILM Sonosite [ultrasound machine][50] is inspired, informed, and improved by thousands of
hours working side-by-side with clinicians, physicians, and professionals on the front lines of
care. Our portfolio consists of intuitive, dependable, user-friendly and easy-to-maintain devices
configured to your pursuit of answers.
* Sonosite iLOOK **For Vascular Access**
  * Easy to use interface
  * Wireless transducer
  * Flexible system mount
  [Discover Sonosite iLOOK][51]
  [iLOOK Full System]
* Sonosite LX **Unmatched Frequency Range**
  * Largest clinical image in the Sonosite portfolio
  * Heads-up workflow offers an inclusive viewing experience
  * Articulating display for optimal bedside access
  [Discover Sonosite LX][52]
  [Sonosite LX]
* Sonosite ST **Procedural Partner**
  * Large all-touchscreen clinical display
  * Intuitive user interface for efficient workflow
  * Streamlined design for flexible access at the bedside
  [Discover Sonosite ST][53]
  [Sonosite ST]

[View Portfolio of Products][54]
[Education W9A5154 RT]
Education

Elevate your POCUS expertise with FUJIFILM Sonosite. We're passionate about empowering clinicians
with educational resources and collaborative support. From our educational institute to our YouTube
channel, system tutorials, 3D scan-along guides and beyond, explore the many ways we support your
learning journey.

[Explore Education][55]

## Leading the charge and not slowing down

In 1997, we set out to provide point-of-care ultrasound for the most dire circumstances. Ever since,
we’ve been focused on only one thing: producing the best ultrasound image we can at the point of
care. As clinicians push boundaries with new applications and approaches to solving medical
challenges from the bedside and beyond, we’re working alongside them, continuously innovating to
enable them to go further.

[Read our innovation story][56]

# The Power of Answers

Supplying advanced digital imaging to healthcare professionals and organizations across the globe.

[Get Answers][49]
Play Pause

## The FUJIFILM Sonosite Portfolio

Every FUJIFILM Sonosite [ultrasound machine][50] is inspired, informed, and improved by thousands of
hours working side-by-side with clinicians, physicians, and professionals on the front lines of
care. Our portfolio consists of intuitive, dependable, user-friendly and easy-to-maintain devices
configured to your pursuit of answers.
* Sonosite iLOOK **For Vascular Access**
  * Easy to use interface
  * Wireless transducer
  * Flexible system mount
  [Discover Sonosite iLOOK][51]
  [iLOOK Full System]
* Sonosite LX **Unmatched Frequency Range**
  * Largest clinical image in the Sonosite portfolio
  * Heads-up workflow offers an inclusive viewing experience
  * Articulating display for optimal bedside access
  [Discover Sonosite LX][52]
  [Sonosite LX]
* Sonosite ST **Procedural Partner**
  * Large all-touchscreen clinical display
  * Intuitive user interface for efficient workflow
  * Streamlined design for flexible access at the bedside
  [Discover Sonosite ST][53]
  [Sonosite ST]

[View Portfolio of Products][54]
[Education W9A5154 RT]
Education

Elevate your POCUS expertise with FUJIFILM Sonosite. We're passionate about empowering clinicians
with educational resources and collaborative support. From our educational institute to our YouTube
channel, system tutorials, 3D scan-along guides and beyond, explore the many ways we support your
learning journey.

[Explore Education][55]

## Leading the charge and not slowing down

In 1997, we set out to provide point-of-care ultrasound for the most dire circumstances. Ever since,
we’ve been focused on only one thing: producing the best ultrasound image we can at the point of
care. As clinicians push boundaries with new applications and approaches to solving medical
challenges from the bedside and beyond, we’re working alongside them, continuously innovating to
enable them to go further.

[Read our innovation story][56]

# **Apollo 24|7 - Your Most Trusted Healthcare Brand**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports. 

## **The Smart Choice for Your Health is Here**

Make the best decision for your health by choosing Apollo 24|7. Here’s why you can count on us:
* 40 years of legacy in the healthcare industry
* 24x7 availability of doctors
* More than 10 million diagnostic tests each year
* 2000+ collection centres and 100+ laboratories
* High quality diagnostic solutions 
* Fast and accurate test report results
* Several medical specialties under one roof
* Order medicines and book tests online with ease
* Digitised health queries

**Ask a Doctor Online 24/7**
Online doctor consultations take place through online doctor chat, call, or video call. This helps
you to talk to doctors online from the comfort of your home by simply choosing a doctor from
different specialties. Avail personalised solutions for any health problem with prompt online doctor
consultation with Apollo 24|7.
* Safe and secure platform
* Video and chat options

**Online Doctor Consultation - Now at Your Fingertips**
The demand for doctors is expected to increase as new medicines allow people to live longer.
However, there are several ways to reach out to a doctor without the need to visit a hospital or
clinic, all thanks to technology. With the online facility available, doctor consultations have
become easier, and you can get the right health care. Online doctor consultations with 5000+ top
medical doctors are available at Apollo 24|7. Video call or chat with expert doctors from 100+
medical specialties, including | [Dermatology][99] | [Gynaecology][100] | [Paediatrics][101] |
[Psychiatry][102] | [General Physicians][103] | [Gastroenterology][104] | [Dietetics][105] | [Ent
Specialists][106] | and more, in just 15 minutes.

Benefits of choosing online doctor consultations:
* Save time, money, and effort.
* No need to travel. 
* Most convenient option to choose from, and helps in early diagnosis.
* Online doctor consultations are confidential and safe.
* No risks of infections.

## **Apollo Hospitals**

Apollo 24|7 is a part of Apollo Hospitals. [Apollo Hospitals][107] was established in 1983 by Dr.
Prathap C Reddy. It incorporates over 10,000 beds across 70 hospitals, over 4000 pharmacies, 172
primary care and diagnostic clinics, and 148 telemedicine facilities spread across 13 countries.
Apollo Hospitals has touched billions of lives by offering exceptional clinical outcomes.

Milestones of Apollo Hospitals:
* 40 Years of legacy and credibility in the healthcare industry. 
* NABL certified multi-channel digital healthcare platform.
* World’s best medical specialists.
* Largest & trusted branded healthcare network.
* Advanced healthcare technology.
   

**Pharmacy Simplified with Apollo 24|7**
Apollo pharmacy is the most credible and established online pharmacy in India. It delivers 100%
original medicines and products. Apollo pharmacy is believed to offer super-fast home delivery for
all the healthcare essentials. Explore our broad range of  products such as baby care, personal
care, wellness, lifestyle, health, and nutrition categories online with ease. 

Rapid deliveries of medicines are available online at Apollo Pharmacy. In some cities, deliveries
are done in less than 24 hours.
* Get health credits on purchasing medicines and products.
* Alluring deals on medicines and other products.
* A broad range of medicines and essential healthcare products to choose from.
* Authentic and top-notch quality products.


**Convenient Diagnostic Lab Tests at Home**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab

secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports.

consultation with Apollo 24|7.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Butterfly iQ+ and Butterfly iQ3?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible
  iPhone or Android smartphone or tablet. Both use Butterfly's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor
  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?
  
  Butterfly replaces traditional ultrasound — both cart-based systems and handheld piezoelectric
  devices — with a single semiconductor-based probe built on Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology.
  Traditional systems require multiple probes, costly hardware maintenance, and dedicated carts.
  Butterfly's single probe performs multiple imaging modes across the whole body with software that
  improves over time, and is priced much lower than what conventional system costs.
  
  ### Does Butterfly use AI in ultrasound?
  
  Yes. Butterfly integrates AI across image capture, clinical workflows, and enterprise management.
  On-device AI tools assist with image guidance, anatomy identification, and real-time feedback.
  Butterfly's CompassAI™ enterprise software automates documentation, quality assurance, and billing
  workflows for point-of-care ultrasound programs.
  
  ### Who uses Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly ultrasound is used by a wide range of healthcare professionals including emergency
  physicians, hospitalists, intensivists, cardiologists, anesthesiologists, primary care providers,
  nurses, paramedics, military medics, and medical students. Butterfly devices are deployed in
  emergency departments, ICUs, operating rooms, outpatient clinics, primary care practices, and
  remote or resource-limited settings.
  
  ### Is AI-assisted ultrasound accurate?
  
  AI-assisted ultrasound tools, including those in Butterfly devices, are designed to improve
  consistency in image acquisition and support clinical workflows — not to replace clinical
  judgment. Butterfly's AI guidance helps clinicians acquire better images faster, which can improve
  the reliability of findings. As with all diagnostic tools, trained clinical interpretation remains
  essential.
  
  ### How much does a Butterfly device cost?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ starts at $2,699 for the handheld probe. Pricing varies based on model, software
  membership tier, and whether the purchase is for individual or enterprise use. Enterprise pricing
  includes additional workflow tools, analytics, and volume options. A Butterfly membership
  subscription is required and unlocks cloud storage, AI-powered features, and ongoing software
  updates.
  
  ### Is a subscription required to use Butterfly?
  
  Yes. A Butterfly membership is required and is designed to expand the device's capabilities over
  time. Membership tiers provide access to cloud storage, workflow tools, and AI-powered features.
  Because Butterfly is a software-driven platform, new capabilities are delivered through software
  updates to the same hardware — meaning the device improves with the membership.
  
  ### What support and training are included with Butterfly?
  
  Butterfly provides onboarding services, in-app guidance, and access to ScanLab™ — an AI-guided,
  simulation-based training application — along with on-demand learning modules and live training
  sessions. Enterprise customers receive additional implementation support, quality assurance tools
  via CompassAI, and dedicated customer success resources. All active memberships include software
  updates and customer support.
  
  ### What is the ROI of handheld ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly Network’s handheld ultrasound delivers ROI through low upfront hardware cost, fast
  clinical decision-making, and reduced reliance on external imaging referrals. A key driver for
  enterprise customers is Butterfly's CompassAI workflow software, which captures documentation in
  real time and reduces unrecorded or 'ghost' scans. By improving billing compliance and capturing
  revenue from scans that would otherwise go undocumented, CompassAI can help health systems realize
  measurable financial returns.
  
  ### Does Butterfly iQ3 work with iPhone and Android?
  
  Yes. Both Butterfly iQ3 and iQ+ are compatible with a range of iPhone and Android smartphones and
  tablets. Clinicians use the Butterfly iQ mobile app to display, capture, and manage ultrasound
  imaging directly on their device. Compatibility details for specific models are available
  [here][66].
  
  ### Do you need internet to use Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  After the app has been downloaded onto a mobile device, the account has been created and the user
  has logged in, the Butterfly probe can be used without the internet.
  
  Please note that Butterfly iQ app must connect to the internet every 30 days. If your device does
  not connect to the internet for 30 days or more, you will be unable to scan until connected to the
  internet.
  
  ### How do I purchase a Butterfly device or request a demo?
  
  Butterfly devices can be purchased directly at butterflynetwork.com by clicking 'Store' in the top
  navigation. To speak with a sales representative or see a live demonstration, click 'Get Demo' in
  the navigation bar and complete the request form.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Butterfly iQ+ and Butterfly iQ3?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible
  iPhone or Android smartphone or tablet. Both use Butterfly's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor
  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?
  
  Butterfly replaces traditional ultrasound — both cart-based systems and handheld piezoelectric
  devices — with a single semiconductor-based probe built on Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology.
  Traditional systems require multiple probes, costly hardware maintenance, and dedicated carts.
  Butterfly's single probe performs multiple imaging modes across the whole body with software that
  improves over time, and is priced much lower than what conventional system costs.
  
  ### Does Butterfly use AI in ultrasound?
  
  Yes. Butterfly integrates AI across image capture, clinical workflows, and enterprise management.
  On-device AI tools assist with image guidance, anatomy identification, and real-time feedback.
  Butterfly's CompassAI™ enterprise software automates documentation, quality assurance, and billing
  workflows for point-of-care ultrasound programs.
  
  ### Who uses Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly ultrasound is used by a wide range of healthcare professionals including emergency
  physicians, hospitalists, intensivists, cardiologists, anesthesiologists, primary care providers,
  nurses, paramedics, military medics, and medical students. Butterfly devices are deployed in
  emergency departments, ICUs, operating rooms, outpatient clinics, primary care practices, and
  remote or resource-limited settings.
  
  ### Is AI-assisted ultrasound accurate?
  
  AI-assisted ultrasound tools, including those in Butterfly devices, are designed to improve
  consistency in image acquisition and support clinical workflows — not to replace clinical
  judgment. Butterfly's AI guidance helps clinicians acquire better images faster, which can improve
  the reliability of findings. As with all diagnostic tools, trained clinical interpretation remains
  essential.
  
  ### How much does a Butterfly device cost?
  
  Butterfly iQ+ starts at $2,699 for the handheld probe. Pricing varies based on model, software
  membership tier, and whether the purchase is for individual or enterprise use. Enterprise pricing
  includes additional workflow tools, analytics, and volume options. A Butterfly membership
  subscription is required and unlocks cloud storage, AI-powered features, and ongoing software
  updates.
  
  ### Is a subscription required to use Butterfly?
  
  Yes. A Butterfly membership is required and is designed to expand the device's capabilities over
  time. Membership tiers provide access to cloud storage, workflow tools, and AI-powered features.
  Because Butterfly is a software-driven platform, new capabilities are delivered through software
  updates to the same hardware — meaning the device improves with the membership.
  
  ### What support and training are included with Butterfly?
  
  Butterfly provides onboarding services, in-app guidance, and access to ScanLab™ — an AI-guided,
  simulation-based training application — along with on-demand learning modules and live training
  sessions. Enterprise customers receive additional implementation support, quality assurance tools
  via CompassAI, and dedicated customer success resources. All active memberships include software
  updates and customer support.
  
  ### What is the ROI of handheld ultrasound?
  
  Butterfly Network’s handheld ultrasound delivers ROI through low upfront hardware cost, fast
  clinical decision-making, and reduced reliance on external imaging referrals. A key driver for
  enterprise customers is Butterfly's CompassAI workflow software, which captures documentation in
  real time and reduces unrecorded or 'ghost' scans. By improving billing compliance and capturing
  revenue from scans that would otherwise go undocumented, CompassAI can help health systems realize
  measurable financial returns.
  
  ### Does Butterfly iQ3 work with iPhone and Android?
  
  Yes. Both Butterfly iQ3 and iQ+ are compatible with a range of iPhone and Android smartphones and
  tablets. Clinicians use the Butterfly iQ mobile app to display, capture, and manage ultrasound
  imaging directly on their device. Compatibility details for specific models are available
  [here][66].
  
  ### Do you need internet to use Butterfly ultrasound?
  
  After the app has been downloaded onto a mobile device, the account has been created and the user
  has logged in, the Butterfly probe can be used without the internet.
  
  Please note that Butterfly iQ app must connect to the internet every 30 days. If your device does
  not connect to the internet for 30 days or more, you will be unable to scan until connected to the
  internet.
  
  ### How do I purchase a Butterfly device or request a demo?
  
  Butterfly devices can be purchased directly at butterflynetwork.com by clicking 'Store' in the top
  navigation. To speak with a sales representative or see a live demonstration, click 'Get Demo' in
  the navigation bar and complete the request form.

## Comfort, Compassion, and Care—At Home

Providing a peaceful and dignified experience for your cherished companions within the sanctuary of

[505-615-2418][1]

10 am - 5:30 pm

Servicing: Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, East Mountains, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Placitas, Bosque Farms,
Los Lunas, and Belen. *Travel fees may apply.

Services

### Private Cremation

$600 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia and the pet's ashes are returned.

### Communal Cremation

$525 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia but the pet's ashes are not returned.

### In-Home Euthanasia

$400 - At home burial: Includes a brief discussion with the veterinarian, a sedation cocktail (for
pain control, anxiety relief, and anesthesia), and euthanasia. Making a paw print and clipping a
lock of fur included. Frame included for paw print.

Taxes and possible travel fee may apply. Please call, text or email for more information.

Additional Services

### Pet Loss Support

We provide gentle guidance and resources to support you after a difficult loss.

### In-Home Ultrasound Imaging

Bring advanced diagnostic care directly to your pet in the comfort of home. Our in-home ultrasound
service provides a safe, convenient, and low-stress way to evaluate your pet's abdomen or heart
without the need to travel to a clinic. Sedation is also available if needed.

### Hospice & Quality-of-Life Evaluation

$200 – Includes an examination by the doctor, a thorough discussion about your pet’s quality of life
and what to expect as their condition progresses. You’ll also receive an email summary of the visit,
sent to you and your regular veterinarian. 50% of this payment can be used for follow-on services
within 7 days.

## In-home Ultrasound Imaging

Experience high-end diagnostic technology without leaving your house, ensuring a tranquil atmosphere
for your loved ones. Our on-site imaging provides deep medical insights while avoiding the anxiety
of clinical visits and transportation. Every session is finalized with a professional analysis from
board-certified specialists to ensure the highest standard of health evaluation for your animal
family members. For more information please visit

[https://www.ultrasoundpaws.com][3]

## Healing In Heartfelt Peace

Navigating the loss of a cherished companion is a journey that requires tender care. We provide
thoughtful resources and a compassionate network to guide you through grief with clinical dignity
and emotional peace.

Opening August 2026

## Comfort, Compassion, and Care—At Home

Providing a peaceful and dignified experience for your cherished companions within the sanctuary of
home.

[505-615-2418][1]

[pets@comfortingpaws.com][2]

Monday - Saturday

Please call, text or email

10 am - 5:30 pm

Servicing: Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, East Mountains, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Placitas, Bosque Farms,
Los Lunas, and Belen. *Travel fees may apply.

Services

### Private Cremation

$600 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia and the pet's ashes are returned.

### Communal Cremation

$525 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia but the pet's ashes are not returned.

### In-Home Euthanasia

$400 - At home burial: Includes a brief discussion with the veterinarian, a sedation cocktail (for
pain control, anxiety relief, and anesthesia), and euthanasia. Making a paw print and clipping a
lock of fur included. Frame included for paw print.

Taxes and possible travel fee may apply. Please call, text or email for more information.

Additional Services

### Pet Loss Support

We provide gentle guidance and resources to support you after a difficult loss.

### In-Home Ultrasound Imaging

Bring advanced diagnostic care directly to your pet in the comfort of home. Our in-home ultrasound
service provides a safe, convenient, and low-stress way to evaluate your pet's abdomen or heart
without the need to travel to a clinic. Sedation is also available if needed.

### Hospice & Quality-of-Life Evaluation

$200 – Includes an examination by the doctor, a thorough discussion about your pet’s quality of life
and what to expect as their condition progresses. You’ll also receive an email summary of the visit,
sent to you and your regular veterinarian. 50% of this payment can be used for follow-on services
within 7 days.

## In-home Ultrasound Imaging

Experience high-end diagnostic technology without leaving your house, ensuring a tranquil atmosphere
for your loved ones. Our on-site imaging provides deep medical insights while avoiding the anxiety
of clinical visits and transportation. Every session is finalized with a professional analysis from
board-certified specialists to ensure the highest standard of health evaluation for your animal
family members. For more information please visit

[https://www.ultrasoundpaws.com][3]

## Healing In Heartfelt Peace

Navigating the loss of a cherished companion is a journey that requires tender care. We provide
thoughtful resources and a compassionate network to guide you through grief with clinical dignity
and emotional peace.

Locally owned and operated

## **BLOG HIGHLIGHTS**

[Dr. Eduard Argaiz- Nephrologist]

**Dr. Eduardo Argaiz, MD, PhD**

*“Some might think it’s logical to go for the cheapest option while still learning, but that’s a
mistake. A high-quality machine is crucial for obtaining clear sonographic views and good-quality
images, especially for novices. A less powerful machine can significantly prolong the learning curve
because obtaining images can be more challenging.”*

**[Read Full Blog ][67]**

[Dr. Benjamin Hibbert- Interventional Cardiologist and Critical Care specialist, MD, PhD]

**Dr. Benjamin Hibbert, MD, PhD**

*“When we use the AI integration in the Kosmos system, we saw an equivalent diagnostic performance
to what we see in experienced users in optimal settings. The AI integration really enabled us to get
excellent diagnostic performance in evaluating these real-world patients with non-expert scanners.
And I think that’s really the impact. The novel finding of this study is that AI integration helped
novice scanners to achieve the diagnostic accuracy that we normally see in experienced scanners.”*

[**Read Full Blog **][68]

[Dr. Peter Fitzgerald- Professor (Research) of Medicine (Cardiovascular), Emeritus, Stanford
University Medical School]

**Dr. Peter Fitzgerald, MD, PhD**

*“Picture this scenario: in my living room, my 21-year-old daughter conducted my echocardiogram
using AI and the [Kosmos] POCUS device, which took just 9 minutes. Consider the revolutionary impact
on diagnosis, potential management, and our perception of healthcare.”*

[**Read Full Blog **][69]

**Dr. Mark Favot, MD**

*“In the ED, 90% of our POCUS exams are abdominal, lung, cardiac or guided vascular access
procedures…Not only can the Kosmos transducers and features easily satisfy those needs, but the AI
on the system provides additional assistance for novice users and helps improve our efficiency when
it comes to quickly calculating an ejection fraction.”*

**[Read Full Blog ][70]**

[Matt Wall, BSN, RN, CPEN]

**Matt Wall, BSN, RN, CPEN**

*“When you have the chance to bring cutting-edge ultrasound into this environment it can be game
changing.”*

[**Read Full Blog **][71]

[Nephrologist Dr. Gregorio Romero Gonzalez]

**Dr. Gregorio Romero González**

*“Kosmos allows AI to support the clinician to obtain great needs for the correct clinical
integration, one of the main objectives of the point of care sonographer.”*

**[Read Full Blog ][72]**

[Dr. Adrian Wong- consultant in Critical Care Medicine and Anesthesiology,]

**Dr. Adrian Wong**

*“[With Kosmos] the feedback is immediate, so you don’t have to go away and reflect or get a mentor
to critique your scan. The software can provide feedback to you in real-time.”*

[**Read Full Blog **][73]

[[HerdIQ- no background]][50]

INNOVATIVE PRODUCTS
Three [wireless probes][51], for large and small animals—handheld, scan direct to iOS or Android
platforms. [Support page is here...][52]
See the [Game Changer][53]—hybrid rectal probe, beautiful images, patent-pending! Now hardwired to
the new LITE NXT and PRO NXT!

 

EDUCATION 
[BOVINE FETAL SEXING][54]4-part video series...register now to watch, FREE! 
Subscribe to our [blog][55] and download our free ebook, ***[Ultrasound Basics][56]***

#### Tough enough

Built for the toughest environments, IBEX and EVO portable veterinary ultrasound systems take
diagnostic  imaging wherever you need it. Engineered and manufactured in the USA, IBEX and
EVO systems are designed with the highest standards of ruggedness, image quality and ease-of-use.

#### Built for veterinary use

Custom-designed broadband transducers, tested to mil-spec standards. High image quality, veterinary
protocols, patient image management, sealed bio-secure casing. Lightweight enough to go anywhere.

#### Customer support program

Service is the hallmark of our business. We engineer systems specifically for veterinary use and
understand the challenges downtime brings. With industry-leading service turnaround times and a
loaner program available, we ensure continuity of your business.

# Veterinary ultrasound...great for your  patients, great for your bottom line

EVO III, SA2, and IBEX^{®} veterinary ultrasound platforms are the latest evolution of portable
ultrasound technology. We deliver great image quality and processing power, all in weather-sealed,
lightweight units. All platforms incorporate user-friendly patient management software. 

We offer a wide variety of probes for any practice or patient. Transducer cables are tested to 1.2
million flex cycles, ensuring seasons of uninterrupted use. 

We are *THE* gold standard for veterinary ultrasound, used in top veterinary hospitals, clinics and
universities. For more information or for a demonstration, contact us at 1.866.365.6596.

As seen on *Shark Week*, *Dr. Oakley Yukon Vet* and *Heartland Docs DVM.*

need to go.  **

# The state of global immunisation

The latest WHO and UNICEF estimates suggest immunisation coverage is improving, particularly in
lower-income countries.

[Read the statement][178] [Explore the data][179]

## Leaving no one behind with immunisation

Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance is a public-private partnership that helps vaccinate more than half the
world’s children against some of the world's deadliest diseases.


[About us][180] [Explore our Progress Report][181]

continuous, integrated care.

## The Gavi Leap

## The Gavi Leap

The Gavi Leap is the most ambitious reform agenda in global health, offering a blueprint for broader
reform of the health and development architecture. Learn more about how Leap principles, such as
country ownership, radical simplification and innovation, are already having a tangible impact on
how immunisation is delivered in Gavi-supported countries.

[Latest on the Leap][196]
[The Gavi Leap]

## Our work

[A mother with her child in Tanzania. Credit: Doune Porter]

### Vaccine portfolio

Gavi supports vaccines against 20 infectious diseases, including Ebola, malaria, mpox and rabies.

[View our vaccines][197]

[A health worker in Tanzania. Credit: Gavi/2012/P Rudden]

### Health systems support

Strong health and immunisation systems are vital to deliver vaccines to all the children who need
them.

[Learn more][198]

[A health worker carrying vaccines in a cold box in Somalia. Credit: Gavi ]

### Civil society support

We provide grants for civil society organisations (CSOs) working to reach zero-dose children and
missed communities with vaccines.

[Our work with CSOs][199]

[[Gavi/2024/Mohamed Abdihakim Ali]][200]

### Shaping vaccine markets

Working to improve the health of markets for vaccines and other immunisation products.

[Learn more][201]

## The Gavi Leap

The Gavi Leap is the most ambitious reform agenda in global health, offering a blueprint for broader
reform of the health and development architecture. Learn more about how Leap principles, such as
country ownership, radical simplification and innovation, are already having a tangible impact on
how immunisation is delivered in Gavi-supported countries.

[Latest on the Leap][196]

# Point-of-care imaging in the palm of your hand

[EagleView is a point-of-care ultrasound solution.]

### View ultrasound images on your phone.

[Explore Now][34]

## Linear, Curved to Phased Array in a Flip

## Choose the Right Handheld Ultrasound for Your Practice

From everyday general imaging to high-frequency superficial scanning, choose the handheld ultrasound
designed for your clinical applications.

### For General Imaging

#### EagleView™ Wireless Handheld Ultrasound

[Shop Now][35]
[EagleView wireless handheld ultrasound]

### For SUPERFICIAL Imaging

#### EagleView™ High-Frequency Linear Wireless Handheld Ultrasound

[Shop Now][36]
[EagleView high-frequency wireless handheld ultrasound]

## Ultimate portable doppler ultrasound solution 

### 1 scanner, 3 arrays

EagleView works as a curvilinear ultrasound probe and a phased array ultrasound probe at the same
time. It is intended for diagnostic ultrasound, echo imaging, measurement, and analysis of the human
body across a wide range of medical applications. Switch from shallow to deep exams by simply
flipping the probe, seamlessly transitioning for comprehensive clinical imaging.

[EagleView Dual-Head Handheld Ultrasound with linear, curved and phased array 3-in-1 probe.]

### Global clinicians share their EagleView scanning experiences

"Through my personal experience of wireless dual head ultrasound machine that EagleView developed,
results were very good and picture quality is good. Cardiac exam for pt with PHTN and hugely dilated
right and left atrium with clear and very good image resolution."

#### Dr. Mustafa Taha From Yemen

"The Eagleview portable ultrasound device is easy to use, versatile, and produces clear,
high-resolution images. This is a great device for portable use in any clinical location."

#### Robert Beatty, MD FACEP, Founder of PPE Medical

" I was able to use the EagleView ultrasound machine for an IJ catheter insertion, the procedure
went well with the help of the ultrasound."

#### Dr. OJ Halum At Dr. Fernando B. Duran Sr. Memorial Hospital

"煽ってるみたいやけど、エコーはまじで個人持ちする時代やと思う円安のせいでちょっと高くなったけど、そ
れでも日本で手に入る他のどのポータブルエコーより安い周術期はもちろん病棟でも家でも使えるマイエコー、
持たない理由がない😇"

#### @kanaesth, Phd Candidate in Public Health from Japan

"I'm glad I had the opportunity to purchase the EagleView ultrasound machine to aid my endeavor.
Although I am still a student, I hope to use this technology to my benefit in future research and
continuous learning!"

#### Sonocratic, DMS Student

"Eagleview ultrasound machine helps us diagnose and treat our patients in the Voluntary Cave Rescue
when we're on a medical mission in east Europe."

#### @CaveRescueOrg, Cave Rescue Organization in Poland

"Excellent ultrasound machine, Congratulations for the quality of the product. As a Physiotherapist
and Osteopath advisor for Switzerland Football Team players (ASF-SFV), I use it often at the World
Cup. "

#### @Alessandro Pernice, Physiotherapist-Osteopath First Team, FIFA+ Sport&Exercise Science BSc

"In my physical examination, feel the viscera of a patient. The hand is no longer enough... so here
comes ultrasound machine. I love ultrasound for the possibility of seeing where the eye doesn't
reach, of feeling inside things, right into the viscera."

#### @ippocrate_md from Italy

[Dr. Alberto profile.jpg.png__PID:f87cb49e-e788-46b9-a4e7-626260111e00]

"Les recomiendo el @EagleViewUltra Llevo 2 años con él y ninguna falla. Bueno, bonito, barato
(comparado a otros). "

# Point-of-care imaging in the palm of your hand

[EagleView is a point-of-care ultrasound solution.]

### View ultrasound images on your phone.

[Explore Now][34]

## Linear, Curved to Phased Array in a Flip

## Choose the Right Handheld Ultrasound for Your Practice

From everyday general imaging to high-frequency superficial scanning, choose the handheld ultrasound
designed for your clinical applications.

### For General Imaging

#### EagleView™ Wireless Handheld Ultrasound

[Shop Now][35]
[EagleView wireless handheld ultrasound]

### For SUPERFICIAL Imaging

#### EagleView™ High-Frequency Linear Wireless Handheld Ultrasound

[Shop Now][36]
[EagleView high-frequency wireless handheld ultrasound]

## Ultimate portable doppler ultrasound solution 

### 1 scanner, 3 arrays

EagleView works as a curvilinear ultrasound probe and a phased array ultrasound probe at the same
time. It is intended for diagnostic ultrasound, echo imaging, measurement, and analysis of the human
body across a wide range of medical applications. Switch from shallow to deep exams by simply
flipping the probe, seamlessly transitioning for comprehensive clinical imaging.

[EagleView Dual-Head Handheld Ultrasound with linear, curved and phased array 3-in-1 probe.]

### Linear Wireless Probe Type Ultrasound Scanner

The high-frequency linear probe provides superficial imaging up to 10cm, from tiny nerves and
vessels to MSK and small parts.

## Advancing the Field,

## Serving the Community

The POCUS Certification Academy is committed to expanding the knowledge and practical application of
point-of-care ultrasound around the world. In partnership with a community of POCUS experts, we
offer certifications and educational opportunities that equip professionals to learn and deliver
unprecedented patient diagnosis, care, and safety while using point-of-care ultrasound.

Whether you are a physician, nurse practitioner, midwife, or anesthetist, the POCUS Certification
Academy has certification opportunities to support your unique practice setting

### 124

#### Countries

124 countries across the globe rely on and recognize POCUS Certifications.

### 150K+

#### Clinicians Certified

150,000+ clinicians have taken advantage of online assessments to get certified.

### 1.8M+

#### Patients Cared For

Certified clinicians care for 1,800,000+ patients each day.

## Start Your Certification Journey Today

[Education & Training Icon]

 

## [Education & Training][39]

Explore our Learning Library or dig deeper and sign up for a course or training program from one of
our POCUS Education Providers.

[POCUS Fundamentals Certificate Icon]

 

## [POCUS Fundamentals Certificate][40]

Combining learning modules and assessments along the way, the Fundamentals Certificate functions as
an introductory course in POCUS, with a focus on the basic physics and instrumentation of
ultrasound. It is a prerequisite for more advanced certifications.

[Clinical & Specialty Certificates Icon]

 

## [Clinical & Specialty Certifications][41]

After successfully completing your Fundamentals Certificate, validate your knowledge of advanced
POCUS use with our Clinical Certifications or bundle them together with one of our Specialty
Certifications.

## More to Explore

[Congratulating Doctor on POCUS certifications]
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

#### New: POCUS HeartFocus Certification Program

Build competency with the HeartFocus app and achieve certification through our newest program.

[Learn More][42]
[Learning Resources]
WEBINAR

#### July 29th @ 12PM | POCUS for Primary Care Physicians

Attendees will walk away with practical POCUS skills across three core exam domains: cardiac,
abdominal & chest, extremities.

[Register Now][43]
RESEARCH

#### POCUS25 Domains

POCUS25 is a ranked list of the top 25 POCUS domains, as determined by survey data obtained through
the POCUS25 research study.

[View List][44]

## Volunteer Today!

### *Help us Elevate the Standards for Better Health Outcomes*

POCUS is dramatically expanding how people use ultrasound around the globe. If you are an
experienced POCUS clinician and would like to help us develop future exam questions, webinar content
and/or blog articles, we would love to hear from you.

[Explore Volunteer Opportunities][45]

## Your Questions, Expertly Answered

**Why should I invest in a portable ultrasound machine?**

Today, the need for cost-effective solutions to a growing patient base has never been greater. Our
portable ultrasound machine for home use or in-clinic services provides the quality diagnostic
images your patients deserve without any costly subscriptions of complicated equipment. With our
tools, great care goes where you* *go.

**Why choose a portable ultrasound machine for point-of-care services?**

Mobile handheld ultrasound devices have become increasingly popular for point-of-care services, and
for *good reason.*

First and foremost, these devices are lightweight and easy to use, giving you and your team the
freedom to treat more patients with fewer headaches. Featuring real-time imaging and crystal-clear
diagnostics, our tools provide clinic-quality services from the comfort of wherever you see your
patients.

Ultimately, this innovative approach to point-of-care services leads to better patient outcomes and
lasting results for your practice, all rolled into one affordable package.

**Which fields utilize portable ultrasound technology?**

We design our products based on feedback from clinicians in various fields, including emergency
medicine, critical care, cardiology, urology, primary care, vascular, obstetrics and gynaecology,
and musculoskeletal imaging.

This allows practitioners to expand the scope of their practice to low-resource communities where
the need for exceptional care has never been more dire. This includes using the portable ultrasound
machine for pregnancy and other home health needs.

**What is dual-probe technology, and why do you use it?**

Our products are designed with an integrated curved and linear array transducer, creating a
dual-probe effect that provides faster imaging and more accurate results. Not only are these
high-frequency probes ideal for imaging superficial structures, such as blood vessels and nerves,
but the low-frequency probe is better suited for imaging deeper structures, such as organs and
bones.

This gives you a versatile diagnostic tool that delivers results in less time, minimizing patient
discomfort and enhancing your overall workflow.

**Can a portable ultrasound machine be used in primary care or internal medicine?**

Yes! In fact, we find that more clinicians prefer the versatility and user-friendly design of our
[portable ultrasound machine][27] over traditional tools. Since these tools are designed for
point-of-care exams, they create more efficiency and better patient engagement in a primary care or
internal medicine setting.

Most importantly, our devices come with no subscription fees or long-term contracts, allowing you to
elevate your care without impacting your budget.

**How are these devices used in emergency medicine?**

Portable ultrasound machines have become increasingly useful in emergency medicine. They provide a
fast and noninvasive diagnostic tool for quickly assessing critical conditions such as pneumothorax,
pericardial effusion, abdominal bleeding and assessing triage patients.

Thanks to their lightweight design and lasting battery power, our machines are the ideal tool for
EMTs, ambulances, and any healthcare provider treating patients in remote locations.

**How does a portable ultrasound machine impact patient care experience?**

Using a portable ultrasound machine gives healthcare providers the power to provide a rapid
diagnosis with minimal discomfort to the patient. This is especially beneficial for pregnant
patients, the elderly, and any patient with limited mobility. Together, we strive to deliver
high-quality diagnostics your patients can count on as quickly and comfortably as possible.

## Your Questions, Expertly Answered

**Why should I invest in a portable ultrasound machine?**

Today, the need for cost-effective solutions to a growing patient base has never been greater. Our
portable ultrasound machine for home use or in-clinic services provides the quality diagnostic
images your patients deserve without any costly subscriptions of complicated equipment. With our
tools, great care goes where you* *go.

**Why choose a portable ultrasound machine for point-of-care services?**

Mobile handheld ultrasound devices have become increasingly popular for point-of-care services, and
for *good reason.*

First and foremost, these devices are lightweight and easy to use, giving you and your team the
freedom to treat more patients with fewer headaches. Featuring real-time imaging and crystal-clear
diagnostics, our tools provide clinic-quality services from the comfort of wherever you see your
patients.

Ultimately, this innovative approach to point-of-care services leads to better patient outcomes and
lasting results for your practice, all rolled into one affordable package.

**Which fields utilize portable ultrasound technology?**

We design our products based on feedback from clinicians in various fields, including emergency
medicine, critical care, cardiology, urology, primary care, vascular, obstetrics and gynaecology,
and musculoskeletal imaging.

This allows practitioners to expand the scope of their practice to low-resource communities where
the need for exceptional care has never been more dire. This includes using the portable ultrasound
machine for pregnancy and other home health needs.

**What is dual-probe technology, and why do you use it?**

Our products are designed with an integrated curved and linear array transducer, creating a
dual-probe effect that provides faster imaging and more accurate results. Not only are these
high-frequency probes ideal for imaging superficial structures, such as blood vessels and nerves,
but the low-frequency probe is better suited for imaging deeper structures, such as organs and
bones.

This gives you a versatile diagnostic tool that delivers results in less time, minimizing patient
discomfort and enhancing your overall workflow.

**Can a portable ultrasound machine be used in primary care or internal medicine?**

Yes! In fact, we find that more clinicians prefer the versatility and user-friendly design of our
[portable ultrasound machine][27] over traditional tools. Since these tools are designed for
point-of-care exams, they create more efficiency and better patient engagement in a primary care or
internal medicine setting.

Most importantly, our devices come with no subscription fees or long-term contracts, allowing you to
elevate your care without impacting your budget.

**How are these devices used in emergency medicine?**

Portable ultrasound machines have become increasingly useful in emergency medicine. They provide a
fast and noninvasive diagnostic tool for quickly assessing critical conditions such as pneumothorax,
pericardial effusion, abdominal bleeding and assessing triage patients.

Thanks to their lightweight design and lasting battery power, our machines are the ideal tool for
EMTs, ambulances, and any healthcare provider treating patients in remote locations.

**How does a portable ultrasound machine impact patient care experience?**

Using a portable ultrasound machine gives healthcare providers the power to provide a rapid
diagnosis with minimal discomfort to the patient. This is especially beneficial for pregnant
patients, the elderly, and any patient with limited mobility. Together, we strive to deliver
high-quality diagnostics your patients can count on as quickly and comfortably as possible.

## Doppler Ultrasound: Know the Price and Benefits

Doppler Ultrasound Price Caters to Substantial Market GrowthThe medical imaging industry has
witnessed remarkable advancements over the past few decades, with innovative technologies proving to
be crucial in diagnosing and treating various medical conditions. Among these technologies, Doppler
ultrasound stands out as a reliable and cost-effective tool for visualizing blood flow within the
body. With its widespread application in obstetrics, cardiology, and vascular imaging, the Doppler
ultrasound market has experienced substantial growth.In recent news, the renowned company {} has
released a range of Doppler ultrasound machines that not only offer exceptional quality but also
come at competitive prices. This move aims to address the demands of an expanding market while
maintaining the company's commitment to providing cutting-edge medical equipment to healthcare
professionals worldwide.Doppler ultrasound is a non-invasive imaging technique that utilizes sound
waves to assess blood flow in real-time. By measuring the frequency shift of the sound waves
reflecting off moving blood cells, physicians can obtain valuable information about the condition of
blood vessels and the efficiency of blood circulation. This imaging modality has proven
indispensable in assessing diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and
even fetal well-being during pregnancy.One of the significant factors contributing to the rising
demand for Doppler ultrasound is its safety and versatility. Unlike other imaging modalities that

maintaining the company's commitment to providing cutting-edge medical equipment to healthcare
professionals worldwide.Doppler ultrasound is a non-invasive imaging technique that utilizes sound
waves to assess blood flow in real-time. By measuring the frequency shift of the sound waves
reflecting off moving blood cells, physicians can obtain valuable information about the condition of
blood vessels and the efficiency of blood circulation. This imaging modality has proven
indispensable in assessing diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and
even fetal well-being during pregnancy.One of the significant factors contributing to the rising
demand for Doppler ultrasound is its safety and versatility. Unlike other imaging modalities that
involve radiation exposure, Doppler ultrasound presents no known risks, making it suitable for
monitoring patients of all ages. Additionally, Doppler ultrasound machines are portable, allowing

precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed

Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

specializes in mammalian and microbial development and manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate

clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

* #### [ Beyond the numbers: Integrating diabetes distress into diabetes care][14]
  
  The emotional and psychological realities of living with diabetes and how they affect a person’s
  ability to engage in self-care were previously not a part of my framework. Now, my practice has
  shifted to embrace a model of diabetes care that values emotional well-being as well as glycemic
  control. I still use grounded tools like A1c and time-in-range data from CGM to guide clinical
  decisions, but I no longer rely on them alone. I have integrated emotional assessment directly in
  my workflow. [Read More][15]

### * [Family Medicine][16]
### * [Internal Medicine][17]

Baray Sidhu and Gerri Klein
Jul 22, 2026

## [Beyond the numbers: Integrating diabetes distress into diabetes care][18]

The emotional and psychological realities of living with diabetes and how they affect a person’s
ability to engage in self-care were previously not a part of my framework. Now, my practice has
shifted to embrace a model of diabetes care that values emotional well-being as well as glycemic
control. I still use grounded tools like A1c and time-in-range data from CGM to guide clinical
decisions, but I no longer rely on them alone. I have integrated emotional assessment directly in my
workflow. [read more...][19]

### * [Technology][20]

Cameron Demee-Fong, Dr. Brian Yong, Dr. Preena Sahota, and Dr. Manstein Kan
Jun 24, 2026

## [Sharing information with QR codes: Perspectives from both primary care and allergy and clinical
## immunology clinics][21]

QR codes and URL shorteners can be used in clinic to improve information-sharing with patients. This
approach reduces paper use, improves access to clinic resources and supports more efficient patient
communication. [read more...][22]

### * [Family Medicine][23]
### * [Hepatology][24]
### * [Infectious Disease][25]

Lukas Hestvik, Nance E Cunningham, Dr. Sofia Bartlett and Dr. Julia MacIsaac
May 27, 2026

## [Hepatitis C treatment in primary care][26]

About 90% of people who have hepatitis C virus (HCV) in BC have uncomplicated cases, meaning they do
not have advanced liver cirrhosis or co-infection with HIV or hepatitis B, and can be treated in
primary care. Treating HCV in my primary care practice has decreased several barriers to treatment
for many of my patients and substantially improved their health. [read more...][27]

### * [Addiction Medicine][28]

Dr. Vivian WL Tsang, Dr. Julius Elefante, and Dr. Paxton Bach

## [Navigating controversies and complexity in concurrent alcohol use, and mood and anxiety
## disorders management][29]

The Canadian Research Initiative in Substance Matters (CRISM) recently published the Canadian
clinical guidelines for the clinical management of high-risk drinking and alcohol use disorder. This
article examines the guideline recommendations regarding the use of selective serotonin reuptake
inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressants for adults and youth with alcohol use disorder. [read more...][30]

### * [Family Medicine][31]

Dr. Ilona Hale
Apr 22, 2026

## [Empowering patients, saving the planet][32]

Shared decision-making (SDM) tools can help patients better understand the absolute risks and
benefits of different testing and treatment options, and allow patients to decide what is right for
them. By empowering patients, I can not only provide better care but also reduce environmental
impacts and unnecessary burdens on the system. [read more...][33]

### * [Addiction Medicine][34]
### * [Infectious Disease][35]

Dr. Julia MacIsaac and Dr. Sofia Bartlett
Mar 25, 2026

## [Universal screening for syphilis and other STBBIs among patients presenting for substance
## use-related care][36]

Patients with substance use disorders are at higher risk for sexually transmitted and blood‑borne
infections (STBBIs), yet screening is often missed due to systemic and patient‑level barriers. This
article describes practical changes that increased STBBI screening rates in our clinic from a
baseline of 6% to 33%. [read more...][37]

### * [Endocrinology][38]
### * [Family Medicine][39]
### * [Obstetrics and Gynaecology][40]

Dr. Kerstin Gustafson and Dr. Colleen Dy
Feb 25, 2026

## [Menopause: Don’t sweat it: Part 2 – Therapies][41]

As care providers, we should be ready to respond to our patients’ midlife concerns with accurate and
evidence-based information. This article explores commonly prescribed preparations for managing
vasomotor symptoms in menopause. [read more...][42]

### * [Family Medicine][43]
### * [Infectious Disease][44]
### * [Public Health][45]

Dr. Sarah McCorquodale & Dr. Trevor Corneil
Jan 28, 2026

## [Recognizing and responding to measles][46]

Endemic measles has returned to BC and Canada, and in 2025 there were 414 cases reported in BC and
5,392 in Canada (confirmed and probable). As such, measles is now on my differential diagnosis for
rash and respiratory illness. I implement appropriate infection control measures in my office to
protect other patients and staff. [read more...][47]

### * [Announcements][48]

Dr. Steve Wong
Dec 11, 2025

## [Letter from the editor][49]

The end of the year offers a natural moment for reflection, gratitude, and looking ahead. I would
like to once again thank everyone who makes This Changed My Practice possible. I'd also like to
touch on AI. AI will likely be both one of the best and one of the most problematic tools we
encounter in health care. AI tools will continue to improve, but I'd like to highlight the ongoing
importance of Human Intelligence—trusted experts who provide context, judgement, and nuance. [read
more...][50]

### * [Infectious Disease][51]

Harleen Chohan, Jenny Hong, SungEun Michelle Kim, Victor Leung and Colin Lee
Oct 22, 2025

## [The case for using 1 gram of Ceftriaxone for community-acquired infections in hospital][52]

In alignment with the recommendations from the BC Provincial Antimicrobial Clinical Expert Committee
(PACE), we now recommend using Ceftriaxone 1 gram IV every 24 hours as the initial dosing regimen
for treating mild to moderate community-acquired pneumonia, urinary tract infections and skin and
soft tissue infections in non-critically ill patients. [read more...][53]

## [New BC Guideline on concussion/mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI)][58]

Concussions/mTBIs aren’t just sports injuries, but falls, vehicle collisions and violence are also
common causes. This article shares the new BC Guideline on concussion/mTBI, which emphasizes early
assessment, active recovery and practical tools for primary care. [read more...][59]

not have advanced liver cirrhosis or co-infection with HIV or hepatitis B, and can be treated in
primary care. Treating HCV in my primary care practice has decreased several barriers to treatment
for many of my patients and substantially improved their health. [read more...][27]

### * [Addiction Medicine][28]

Dr. Vivian WL Tsang, Dr. Julius Elefante, and Dr. Paxton Bach

## [Navigating controversies and complexity in concurrent alcohol use, and mood and anxiety
## disorders management][29]

The Canadian Research Initiative in Substance Matters (CRISM) recently published the Canadian
clinical guidelines for the clinical management of high-risk drinking and alcohol use disorder. This
article examines the guideline recommendations regarding the use of selective serotonin reuptake
inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressants for adults and youth with alcohol use disorder. [read more...][30]

### * [Family Medicine][31]

Dr. Ilona Hale
Apr 22, 2026

## [Empowering patients, saving the planet][32]

Shared decision-making (SDM) tools can help patients better understand the absolute risks and
benefits of different testing and treatment options, and allow patients to decide what is right for
them. By empowering patients, I can not only provide better care but also reduce environmental
impacts and unnecessary burdens on the system. [read more...][33]

### * [Addiction Medicine][34]
### * [Infectious Disease][35]

Dr. Julia MacIsaac and Dr. Sofia Bartlett
Mar 25, 2026

## [Universal screening for syphilis and other STBBIs among patients presenting for substance
## use-related care][36]

Patients with substance use disorders are at higher risk for sexually transmitted and blood‑borne
infections (STBBIs), yet screening is often missed due to systemic and patient‑level barriers. This
article describes practical changes that increased STBBI screening rates in our clinic from a
baseline of 6% to 33%. [read more...][37]

### * [Endocrinology][38]
### * [Family Medicine][39]
### * [Obstetrics and Gynaecology][40]

Dr. Kerstin Gustafson and Dr. Colleen Dy
Feb 25, 2026

## [Menopause: Don’t sweat it: Part 2 – Therapies][41]

As care providers, we should be ready to respond to our patients’ midlife concerns with accurate and
evidence-based information. This article explores commonly prescribed preparations for managing
vasomotor symptoms in menopause. [read more...][42]

### * [Family Medicine][43]
### * [Infectious Disease][44]
### * [Public Health][45]

Dr. Sarah McCorquodale & Dr. Trevor Corneil
Jan 28, 2026

## [Recognizing and responding to measles][46]

Endemic measles has returned to BC and Canada, and in 2025 there were 414 cases reported in BC and
5,392 in Canada (confirmed and probable). As such, measles is now on my differential diagnosis for
rash and respiratory illness. I implement appropriate infection control measures in my office to
protect other patients and staff. [read more...][47]

### * [Announcements][48]

Dr. Steve Wong
Dec 11, 2025

## [Letter from the editor][49]

The end of the year offers a natural moment for reflection, gratitude, and looking ahead. I would
like to once again thank everyone who makes This Changed My Practice possible. I'd also like to
touch on AI. AI will likely be both one of the best and one of the most problematic tools we
encounter in health care. AI tools will continue to improve, but I'd like to highlight the ongoing
importance of Human Intelligence—trusted experts who provide context, judgement, and nuance. [read
more...][50]

### * [Infectious Disease][51]

Harleen Chohan, Jenny Hong, SungEun Michelle Kim, Victor Leung and Colin Lee
Oct 22, 2025

## [The case for using 1 gram of Ceftriaxone for community-acquired infections in hospital][52]

In alignment with the recommendations from the BC Provincial Antimicrobial Clinical Expert Committee
(PACE), we now recommend using Ceftriaxone 1 gram IV every 24 hours as the initial dosing regimen
for treating mild to moderate community-acquired pneumonia, urinary tract infections and skin and
soft tissue infections in non-critically ill patients. [read more...][53]

### * [Emergency Medicine][54]
### * [Family Medicine][55]
### * [Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation][56]
### * [Sport Medicine][57]

Dr. David Wilson & Hilary Cullen
Sep 24, 2025

## [New BC Guideline on concussion/mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI)][58]

Concussions/mTBIs aren’t just sports injuries, but falls, vehicle collisions and violence are also
common causes. This article shares the new BC Guideline on concussion/mTBI, which emphasizes early
assessment, active recovery and practical tools for primary care. [read more...][59]

### * [Neurology][60]
### * [Psychiatry][61]

Dr. Caroline Dance, Dr. Laila Drabkin, Dr. Andrew Howard, Dr. Joseph Tham

This article aims to provide a structured approach to somatic symptom disorder and functional
neurological disorder presentations, with a hope of supporting clinical care, reducing stigma and
improving clinician confidence. [read more...][63]

Why Ultrasound Fanatic?

**Ultrasound Fanatic** is the **leading POCUS training platform and ultrasound resource hub**,
offering real-time ultrasound simulation, portable ultrasound device reviews, and hands-on learning
for clinicians, students, and educators. Unlike traditional ultrasound courses, our ultrasound app
provides interactive case-based scenarios to help you develop clinical confidence and proficiency in
POCUS.

What is the Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App?

The **Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App** is an AI-powered ultrasound simulation tool designed to
help users master point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) through interactive training modules, real-life
case studies, and image interpretation exercises. Available on the **App Store and Google Play** and
Android devices, **the ultrasound app allows you to practice POCUS anytime, anywhere—without needing
an actual ultrasound machine.**

📲 Download the app today and start improving your ultrasound skills!

How Can I Improve My Ultrasound Skills?

The best way to improve your ultrasound skills is through **hands-on practice** and **real-world
case simulations.** The **Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App** offers:

✅ Step-by-step ultrasound protocols for rapid skill development
✅ Real patient cases & pathology-based training
✅ Instant feedback and AI-guided learning

Mastering point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) is essential for emergency medicine, critical care,
primary care, and bedside diagnostics—start training with Ultrasound Fanatic today!

Do I Need an Ultrasound Probe to Use the App?

No! The **Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App** is a fully interactive ultrasound simulator that lets
you practice POCUS protocols, scan techniques, and pathology recognition using only your phone or
tablet. This makes it ideal for **medical students, residents, and healthcare providers** who want
to sharpen their ultrasound skills without requiring access to a physical ultrasound machine.

How Do I Download the Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App?

Downloading the **Ultrasound Fanatic Simulator App** is quick and easy! The app is available on the
**App Store and Google Play**, giving you access to on-demand ultrasound simulation training,
interactive POCUS education, and AI-driven learning tools—all from your mobile device.

With ultrasound simulations, real-world POCUS cases, gamified learning, and hands-on practice
modules, the app helps you build confidence, improve accuracy, and sharpen your ultrasound skills
anytime, anywhere.

## **FAQs on Medical Equipment & Devices**

#### What are medical equipments?

 Medical equipment comprises a broad range of devices and tools used in the diagnosis, monitoring,
treatment, and prevention of diseases. These include instruments such as diagnostic imaging machines
(X-ray, MRI, [ultrasound][48]), therapeutic devices (ventilators, infusion pumps, dialysis
machines), and various support tools found in hospitals, clinics, and laboratories. They play a
critical role in enabling healthcare professionals to provide accurate diagnoses and effective
treatments.

##### What are types of medical devices?

 Medical devices can be classified into several types based on their functions:
* **Diagnostic Devices:** Such as imaging systems, blood testing equipment, and
  [electrocardiographs][49].
* **Therapeutic Devices:** Including devices like ventilators, infusion pumps, and surgical lasers
  used in treatment.
* **Monitoring Devices:** For continuous observation of patient vitals (e.g., ECG monitors, blood
  pressure monitors, pulse oximeters).
* **Surgical Instruments:** Tools used during surgeries like scalpels, forceps, and laparoscopic
  instruments.

**Laboratory Equipment:** Devices used in clinical laboratories for testing and analysis.

##### What are the main medical devices?

 Key medical devices essential for patient care include:
* **Imaging Systems:** X-ray machines, CT scanners, MRI, and ultrasound equipment that help
  visualize internal structures.
* **Diagnostic Tools:** Devices such as blood analyzers, ECG machines, and digital thermometers that
  assist in identifying conditions.
* **Monitoring Systems:** Equipment that continuously tracks patient vitals (e.g., heart rate
  monitors, blood pressure monitors).
* **Surgical Instruments:** Instruments designed for precision in surgical procedures, from basic
  tools like scalpels to advanced robotic systems.

**Life Support Systems:** Ventilators and infusion pumps that are critical in intensive care
settings.

##### What is included in a medical device?

 A medical device generally encompasses:
* **The Core Instrument or Machine:** This is the primary piece of equipment designed to perform a
  specific medical function.
* **Components and Accessories:** Sensors, cables, power supplies, and user interfaces that work in
  conjunction with the core device.
* **Software:** In many modern devices, software is integrated to process data, provide user
  feedback, or enable connectivity.

**Packaging and Documentation:** Essential for ensuring proper usage, maintenance, and compliance
with regulatory standards.

* **Stringent Quality Control:** Implementation of international standards such as ISO, CE, or FDA

* **Regular Maintenance and Calibration:** Ensuring equipment remains in optimal condition through

**Supplier Audits and Certifications:** Vetting and continuously monitoring manufacturers and

**Innovative Solutions:** Continuous investment in research and development to stay ahead in a

##### How do healthcare companies in Dubai maintain advanced medical devices?

 Maintenance of advanced medical devices in Dubai is achieved through:
* **Preventive Maintenance Programs:** Regular scheduled inspections and servicing to prevent

* **Calibration and Software Updates:** Ongoing calibration and software updates to ensure devices

**Training for In-house Staff:** Continuous training ensures that local teams are capable of

## **FAQs on Medical Equipment & Devices**

#### What are medical equipments?

 Medical equipment comprises a broad range of devices and tools used in the diagnosis, monitoring,
treatment, and prevention of diseases. These include instruments such as diagnostic imaging machines
(X-ray, MRI, [ultrasound][48]), therapeutic devices (ventilators, infusion pumps, dialysis
machines), and various support tools found in hospitals, clinics, and laboratories. They play a
critical role in enabling healthcare professionals to provide accurate diagnoses and effective
treatments.

##### What are types of medical devices?

 Medical devices can be classified into several types based on their functions:
* **Diagnostic Devices:** Such as imaging systems, blood testing equipment, and
  [electrocardiographs][49].
* **Therapeutic Devices:** Including devices like ventilators, infusion pumps, and surgical lasers
  used in treatment.
* **Monitoring Devices:** For continuous observation of patient vitals (e.g., ECG monitors, blood
  pressure monitors, pulse oximeters).
* **Surgical Instruments:** Tools used during surgeries like scalpels, forceps, and laparoscopic
  instruments.

**Laboratory Equipment:** Devices used in clinical laboratories for testing and analysis.

##### What are the main medical devices?

 Key medical devices essential for patient care include:
* **Imaging Systems:** X-ray machines, CT scanners, MRI, and ultrasound equipment that help
  visualize internal structures.
* **Diagnostic Tools:** Devices such as blood analyzers, ECG machines, and digital thermometers that
  assist in identifying conditions.
* **Monitoring Systems:** Equipment that continuously tracks patient vitals (e.g., heart rate
  monitors, blood pressure monitors).
* **Surgical Instruments:** Instruments designed for precision in surgical procedures, from basic
  tools like scalpels to advanced robotic systems.

**Life Support Systems:** Ventilators and infusion pumps that are critical in intensive care
settings.

##### What is included in a medical device?

 A medical device generally encompasses:
* **The Core Instrument or Machine:** This is the primary piece of equipment designed to perform a
  specific medical function.
* **Components and Accessories:** Sensors, cables, power supplies, and user interfaces that work in
  conjunction with the core device.
* **Software:** In many modern devices, software is integrated to process data, provide user
  feedback, or enable connectivity.

**Packaging and Documentation:** Essential for ensuring proper usage, maintenance, and compliance
with regulatory standards.

##### How do medical equipment suppliers in Dubai ensure quality?

 Suppliers in Dubai ensure quality through a multi-layered approach:
* **Stringent Quality Control:** Implementation of international standards such as ISO, CE, or FDA
  approvals to guarantee product safety and effectiveness.
* **Rigorous Testing:** Continuous testing of devices before distribution, including performance,
  durability, and safety assessments.
* **Regular Maintenance and Calibration:** Ensuring equipment remains in optimal condition through
  scheduled servicing and calibration.

**Supplier Audits and Certifications:** Vetting and continuously monitoring manufacturers and
service providers to maintain high standards.

##### What distinguishes medical equipment supply in the UAE?

 Medical equipment supply in the UAE is distinguished by:
* **Localized Expertise:** Suppliers understand the specific needs of the region, tailoring their
  offerings to local healthcare environments.
* **Advanced Technology Integration:** A focus on incorporating the latest technological
  advancements to ensure state-of-the-art healthcare solutions.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Adherence to strict international and local standards ensures
  reliability and safety.

**Innovative Solutions:** Continuous investment in research and development to stay ahead in a
competitive global market.

##### How do healthcare companies in Dubai maintain advanced medical devices?

 Maintenance of advanced medical devices in Dubai is achieved through:
* **Preventive Maintenance Programs:** Regular scheduled inspections and servicing to prevent
  equipment failure.
* **Calibration and Software Updates:** Ongoing calibration and software updates to ensure devices
  operate accurately and efficiently.
* **Service Contracts and Support Teams:** Dedicated technical teams and service agreements that
  provide rapid response and repair services.

**Training for In-house Staff:** Continuous training ensures that local teams are capable of
handling routine maintenance and troubleshooting.

##### What training programs are available for medical equipment companies in UAE?

 Training programs for medical equipment companies typically include:
* **Technical Training Courses:** Focused on the operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of
  advanced medical equipment.
* **Certification Programs:** Recognized courses that provide certification in medical device
  handling and safety protocols.
* **Continuous Education Initiatives:** Regular workshops and seminars to keep professionals updated
  on the latest technological advances and regulatory changes.

**Customized On-Site Training:** Tailored programs for healthcare facilities to ensure staff are
fully versed in the unique requirements of their equipment.

##### How can medical supply store services improve patient care?

* **Technical Support and After-Sales Service:** Continuous support helps troubleshoot and resolve

**Streamlined Inventory Management:** Efficient management of supplies ensures that critical devices

enhancing international exchanges and fostering business partnerships across borders. �� Unveiling

# VIA in the cloud

Now you can experience VIA with the flexibility and simplicity of cloud computing. With VIA in the
cloud, you get ALL of the benefits of fully featured and integrated veterinary software without the
issues of installing or maintaining software on your own computers. Your hospital data safely
resides on cloud servers and you have the freedom to access your data from your home, hospital or
anywhere.
* Fully integrated with in-house lab equipment and external laboratories
* Built in DICOM Modality Worklist and image viewing for use with x-ray, ultrasound, CT
* Built in eTreatment Flowsheets and eWhiteboards
* Better communication with built in email and instant messenger
* Comprehensive management modules for reporting, reminders, and inventory control
* No expensive third party vendors required for core features like DICOM, flowsheets, and accounting

## **About Us **

VIA Information Systems is a leading provider of veterinary practice management software and has
served the veterinary community since 1999.

VIA is an Antech company and part of Mars Veterinary Health. At Mars Veterinary Health, we are
dedicated to advancing the veterinary profession and living our Purpose: A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS.
Through our growing global network of over 2,500 veterinary clinics and hospitals in over 21
countries, we make industry-leading pet care available for more than 25 million pet visits every
year and provide solutions for diagnostic imaging, veterinary hospital information software, and
clinical laboratory services.

## **About Us **

VIA Information Systems is a leading provider of veterinary practice management software and has
served the veterinary community since 1999.

VIA is an Antech company and part of Mars Veterinary Health. At Mars Veterinary Health, we are
dedicated to advancing the veterinary profession and living our Purpose: A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS.
Through our growing global network of over 2,500 veterinary clinics and hospitals in over 21
countries, we make industry-leading pet care available for more than 25 million pet visits every

**ULTRASOUND – TECHNOLOGY OF THE FUTURE**

## Harness the power of ultrasonic technology

At VIAL Automation, we believe technology is more than just machinery. It’s a strategic tool for
**enhancing efficiency, precision, and sustainability.** Our solutions encompass the integration of
ultrasonic components, the automation of production lines, and custom-engineered development
designed to meet the specific objectives of our partners.

Ultrasonic technology plays a critical role across diverse sectors, including **automotive, medical,
food processing, and electronics**.

We take pride in our in-house, **R&D-focused ultrasonic laboratory**, which is among the leading
facilities in the region. We support our clients throughout the entire lifecycle: from** initial
component design** and laboratory feasibility testing to prototyping and **final implementation in
full-scale series production**.

**A cleaner joining technology:** Ultrasonic welding is fundamentally sustainable. By eliminating
the need for hazardous chemical solvents, adhesives, and single-use mechanical consumables, this
technology actively protects the environment. Furthermore, the ultrasonic process consumes
electrical power only in the specific milliseconds of the weld cycle, drastically reducing overall
energy waste compared to continuous heat-sealing methods.

energy waste compared to continuous heat-sealing methods.
